newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves at 13-month high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves at 13-month high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.38 billion as of November 30, the most recent date for which officials figures are available, the central bank said.
The reserve figure was the highest reported by the central bank, or Banco de la Republica, since Oct 28 of last year.

A recent increase in foreign investment, coupled with a surge in dollar-denominated loans and lower demand for U.S. currency have contributed to the increase in Colombia's overall foreign reserves. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
